final: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entry_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), race_average AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS average_count FROM race_totals) SELECT rt.raceId, rt.country, rt.total_points, rt.entry_count, rt.entry_count - ra.average_count AS above_average FROM race_totals AS rt CROSS JOIN race_average AS ra WHERE rt.entry_count > ra.average_count ORDER BY above_average DESC LIMIT 10
